## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api was failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1), with an error rate of 0.18 and unhealthy status in all production regions.

**Actions taken:**

1. **Investigated** — Service status showed v2.3.1 deployed to all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and unhealthy. Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was older).

**Final state:** checkout-api is on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy**, with error rate down to 0.002.
